landing.headDesc: Instant, transparent, fraud-proof school fee payments on the Stellar blockchain. Auto-reconciliation via transaction memos.
landing.heroSub: Blockchain-powered payments that eliminate manual reconciliation, prevent fraud, and give parents instant proof — for a fraction of a cent per transaction.
landing.featuresP: No PDFs. No bank transfers. No chasing payments. Just transparent, instant, verifiable transactions on a public blockchain.
landing.featSettlementDesc: Stellar confirms transactions faster than a credit card swipe. Parents get instant proof of payment.
landing.featImmutabilityDesc: Every payment is permanently recorded on a public blockchain. Receipts that can never be faked or lost.
landing.featReconciliationDesc: Student IDs in the Stellar memo field automatically match every payment — no spreadsheets required.
landing.featCostDesc: Forget 2.9% + 30¢. Stellar's fees are microscopic. Every dollar goes toward education.
landing.featMultiSchoolDesc: Fully isolated wallets, students, and records per institution. Scale from one school to a district.
landing.featRealtimeDesc: Server-sent events push live payment confirmations to parents and admins the instant they land.
landing.howP: Parents pay. Stellar confirms. StellarEduPay matches, validates, and records — automatically.
landing.howStep1Desc: They see the school wallet address, their student's ID as a pre-filled memo, the exact amount owed, and accepted assets (XLM or USDC).
landing.howStep2Title: They send from any Stellar wallet
landing.howStep2Desc: Lobstr, Solar, XBULL — any wallet works. The transaction hits the Stellar network and confirms in seconds.
landing.howStep3Desc: The poller reads the blockchain, matches the memo to the student, validates the amount, marks the fee paid, and fires a webhook.
landing.ctaP: Everything is already live. Connect a school wallet, register students, and start accepting on-chain fee payments today.
